ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions .
   B. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Modes of preservation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.
   D. Use Modes of preservation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in revealed scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in revealed scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in revealed scriptures.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in revealed scriptures has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected verses has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.
   D. Say Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj and Umrah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah.
   C. Say Hajj and Umrah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Commanding good and forbidding evil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam promise management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. A — Apply the teaching of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. D — Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
